VTS Scoring Log

Atomik Labz

atomiklabz.com · Est. ~2024 · JE Production Enterprises LLC · Scored August 2026

Atomik Labz requires account registration to access the site - all products, documentation, and policy pages are login-gated. No testing laboratory is named in any publicly accessible content. The operating entity JE Production Enterprises LLC DBA Atomik Labz is disclosed in the SMS consent text of the publicly visible registration form - the only entity-level disclosure accessible without an account. The site operates under at least two domains (atomiklabz.com and atomiklabzpeptides.com) with no public explanation. Finnrick independently tracks 43 tests across 9 products. An independent Finnrick analysis of this vendor identified entity name changes in public records and Florida registry inconsistencies; that report maps connections to related brands under the same operator. These findings are documented in Community Signal and do not directly score into VTS dimensions.

Community Signal
Independent Test Results
Finnrick independently tracks 43 tests across 9 Atomik Labz products. Finnrick's 2026 analysis of this vendor (29 pages, 7 risk factors assessed, July 2026) maps entity structure, related brands, and batch-specific complaints. This is Community Signal data; specific Finnrick test results for this vendor are available through Finnrick's public platform at finnrick.com/vendors/atomik-labz.
Community Experience & Operator Flags
Community feedback on shipping and product delivery is generally positive across available reviews. At least one documented review reported adverse reactions across multiple pill products from this vendor. Finnrick's corporate records analysis found that this vendor traces from prior entity names, with Florida registry inconsistencies and connections to Solution Peptides and Warrior Peptides documented in their report. PeptideClear does not independently verify the Finnrick entity analysis, but notes its existence as a community signal for researchers conducting due diligence.
Scoring Notes
The registration requirement is the most friction-intensive in the catalog
Creating an Atomik Labz account requires: first name, last name, phone number, company name, account type (business/institution with EIN required, or independent researcher), website, business type, how you heard about them, full address, city, state, and postal code. For a business account, an EIN (Tax ID) is mandatory. This is a substantially higher barrier to entry than simply creating an email-and-password account. A researcher who wants to review documentation before purchasing must provide personal and business information in full before seeing any product or COA.
Entity disclosure in consent text is the only public anchor
Most vendors disclose their operating entity on the homepage footer, an About page, or a Terms page. Atomik Labz discloses JE Production Enterprises LLC only in the SMS consent checkbox text on the registration form. This is a verifiable disclosure - the text is publicly visible - but it is a non-standard location that a casual visitor would not encounter without attempting to register.
Sources: atomiklabz.com (homepage and registration form visible without login), Finnrick independent testing and operator analysis at finnrick.com/vendors/atomik-labz, third-party vendor review documentation. VTS measures process transparency from publicly available materials only. It is not a certification of product safety, purity, or efficacy. PeptideClear has no affiliate, referral, or commercial relationship with Atomik Labz. Scored August 2026 - reviewed on a rolling basis as vendor practices change.
